messages:
Sonia (People Ops): Quick sync — we need to finalize handbook wording for the "Hybrid time & remote exceptions" section and run a short compliance micro-training for managers. Goal: consistent language + a manager completion tracker. Can folks help with two things: 1) quick wording review (2–3 ppl) 2) owning manager training RSVP/verification (1 owner). I'll publish a PR to the handbook once we have sign-offs.

Alex K: Quick q — is the training mandatory for contractors who lead teams?

Sonia (People Ops): For now it's mandatory for managers (people managers and tech leads with direct reports). Contractors: recommended, but not required unless they're managing >3 headcount. We can discuss exceptions case-by-case.

Jamal R: Are we doing EU/localized versions? need translations for French/DE.

Lina (Localization): Confirmed — we have a localized slide deck for EU regions and a translated ack text. I can attach the files once Sonia shares the final wording.

Eli: I can volunteer to do the wording pass (short read). Prefer to do the review today or tomorrow.

Marta: Timeline? when does this need to ship to payroll/people managers?

Sonia (People Ops): Targeting handbook publish 2026-04-10 and training windows 2026-03-31 and 2026-04-07 (drop-in sessions). RSVP sheet live now. Please add manager completions to the tracker by EOD next Friday.

Sonia (People Ops): Tracker CSV header (paste into tracker or sheet import):
```csv
manager_name,team,completed(yes/no),completion_ts,trainer,notes
```

Alex K: link to sheet?

Sonia (People Ops): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/placeholder-handbook-tracker — I'll DM access to anyone who can't access.

Lina (Localization): Small note on wording — avoid using “flex credits” in the policy text; say “flex time allocation” instead. Keeps translation consistent.

Eli: reading pass done — left inline suggestions in the doc. Main thing: tighten the second paragraph about approval flow, add a one-sentence example to clarify on-call overlap.

Marta: Can People Ops Bot send a reminder to managers to fill the tracker after PR merges?

PeopleOpsBot: Reminder scheduled — RSVP reminder in 48 hours, completion nudge two days before 2026-04-10.

Jamal R: Any legal review required? want to loop in compliance for EU-specific wording.

Sonia (People Ops): Yes — looping in Legal for EU localization. @Lina please share localized strings and I'll add Legal to the thread.

Lina (Localization): Will do, attaching localized deck and ack text after final sign-off.

Alex K: :thumbsup: I'll update my team and add their managers to the tracker.

Eli: happy to be backup reviewer for the 4/7 session if needed.

Sonia (People Ops): Awesome — thank you all. Action items: 1) Eli — finalize wording pass (today) 2) Lina — prepare localized assets after final text 3) Alex/Marta — push tracker updates for your teams 4) Sonia — merge PR and publish handbook 2026-04-10. I'll post the handbook PR link in this thread when ready.

PeopleOpsBot: Note: please ensure managers enter completion rows in the tracker in the CSV format above to make exports/SLAs easier.

Sonia (People Ops): Follow-up: PR opened https://git.company/handbook/policies/1234 — please add quick review by EOD. Thanks!
